name: WhatsApp Business
description: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API for sending and receiving messages and managing accounts.
auth_notes: Access tokens sent as Bearer in the Authorization header; system user tokens, or Business Integration System User tokens when acting for clients.
gate_detail: Developers can generate a temporary test token via a Meta app. Production use for other businesses' accounts needs App Review with Advanced access, plus partner onboarding for Tech Providers.
api_scope: Cloud API for messaging and calling, Business Management API for account assets, Marketing Messages API, Groups API and Embedded Signup onboarding.
mcp_notes: Meta runs official remote MCP servers including a WhatsApp Business Tools MCP; its URL is not visible in the sources.
blocker_detail: App Review for Advanced access permissions is required to access WABAs not owned by your business.

evidence.quote: Click **Generate access token** to generate a temporary access token to send a test message.
You will need to set up a webhook endpoint in order to receive notifications about message statuses
Meta runs official remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
every call needs a system user access token.

issues: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP URL is cut off in the source.
REST style is inferred from HTTP calls, not labeled.
No dedicated sandbox is described beyond a temporary test token.
